SelectFileDescriptionGoogle: Select the Google Workspace backup files to start the data import. Multiple files can be selected. Once the data upload and analysis are complete, the next step will be initiated automatically.

SelectFileDescriptionWorkspace: Select the {{organizationName}} Workspace backup file to start the data import. Once the data upload and analysis are complete, the next step will be initiated automatically.
SelectUsersDescriptionGoogle: Check users from the list to import into {{organizationName}} {{productName}}. Users from Google Workspace will be imported without First Name / Last Name, and their email name will be used instead. Names of the users can be changed after the import. Users already existing in {{organizationName}} {{productName}} are highlighted with a green color and are not checked by default.
SelectUsersDescriptionNextcloud: Check users from the list to import into {{organizationName}} {{productName}}. Only users with emails can be selected. Users already existing in {{organizationName}} {{productName}} are highlighted with a green color and are not checked by default.
SelectUsersDescriptionWorkspace: Check users from the list to import into {{organizationName}} {{productName}}. Users already existing in {{organizationName}} {{productName}} are highlighted with a green color and are not checked by default.

TypesAndPrivileges:
<1>Admin account types and their privileges

<2>Full admin
Workspace configuration, room creation and administration, ability to invite and manage users in the workspace and in virtual rooms, ability to manage access rights.

<3>Room admin
Room administration and archiving, user invitation and management. Several admins can be assigned to a room.

<4>User
Users can create and edit files in the room, but can't create rooms, manage users, or access settings.
